proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on the Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, consistent with applicable law.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Have an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy requiring the Chair of the Board, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
